meta.baseChapterLabel: Lesson 11: Describing Impressions: It Was Beautiful

items.target: セールはやすかったですか
items.reviewNote: Dialogue Exercise A item 1 (セール、やすいです), Nakamura's line completed on the printed example えいがはおもしろかったですか. セール is carded as bare vocabulary only.

items.target: このほんはつまらなくないです
items.note: つまらない (tsumaranai) ends in ない (nai) but is an ordinary い-adjective, so it negates like one: つまらなくないです (tsumaranakunai desu), never つまらないじゃありません (tsumaranai ja arimasen).
items.reviewNote: Paradigm gap: boring / present negative. Constructed sentence, second of the このほんは〜 fixed frame. Carries the つまらない trap note.

items.target: テストはむずかしくないです
items.reviewNote: Paradigm gap: difficult / present negative. Constructed sentence, second of the テストは〜 fixed frame.

items.english: Yesterday it was hot, but today it's cool.
items.target: きのうはあつかったですが、きょうはすずしいです
items.pronunciation: kinō wa atsukatta desu ga, kyō wa suzushii desu
items.reviewNote: Contrast Exercise item 2 (あついです、すずしいです), completed on the printed example. Missing from the deck.

items.target: きのうのおまつりはきれいでした
items.pronunciation: kinō no omatsuri wa kirei deshita
items.reviewNote: Substitution Exercise C, the printed example sentence itself. The deck carded the にぎやか version but skipped the きれい example the exercise is built on.

items.target: パーティーはどうでしたか
items.reviewNote: Dialogue Exercise B, Kato's line in the printed example. The deck has コンサートはどうでしたか and テストはどうでしたか from the same exercise but skipped the example itself.

items.target: とてもたのしかったです
items.reviewNote: Dialogue Exercise B, Emma's line in the printed example; the same line also closes the weekend-skiing dialogue example and Speaking Practice 1. Deck has bare たのしかったです only. Elliptical, so it carries a scene.

items.english: Over the weekend, I went to Hakone.
items.target: しゅうまつにはこねにいきました
items.reviewNote: Speaking Practice 2, Smith's opening line. Missing from the deck; はこね was introduced back in Lesson 8 and only ever carded as a place name.

items.english: I walked for about eight hours.
items.target: ８じかんぐらいあるきました
items.ttsText: はちじかんぐらいあるきました
items.reviewNote: Target Dialogue and repeated in NOTES 1 as the paired answer to どのくらいあるきましたか. Deck has ８じかん and ぐらい as vocabulary only.

items.english: Thank you for the souvenir yesterday, Smith-san.
items.target: スミスさん、きのうはおみやげをありがとうございました
items.pronunciation: sumisu san, kinō wa omiyage o arigatō gozaimashita
items.reviewNote: Speaking Practice 3, Nakamura's opening line, and the worked example for NOTES 2 on past-tense thanks. The deck has bare どうもありがとうございました but no sentence showing what you are thanking someone for.

items.target: このほんはつまらないです
items.note: The ない (nai) on the end belongs to the word itself, not to a negative ending, so this is the plain affirmative.
items.reviewNote: Paradigm gap: boring / present affirmative. Constructed sentence; first of the four-card このほんは〜 fixed frame that cycles つまらない through all four forms. Chosen to sit against the existing このほんはおもしろいです from Lesson 10.

items.target: はい、やすかったです
items.scene: answering whether the sale was cheap
items.reviewNote: Dialogue Exercise A item 1, Emma's line completed on the printed example はい、おもしろかったです. Elliptical answer, so it carries a scene.

items.target: パーティーはにぎやかじゃありませんでした
items.pronunciation: pātī wa nigiyaka ja arimasen deshita
items.reviewNote: Excluded by the semantic de-dup pass. Pattern: [topic]は[na-adj]じゃありませんでした. Source already teaches this na-adjective past-negative pattern twice (きのうのおまつりはきれいじゃありませんでした, しゅっちょうはたいへんじゃありませんでした).

items.target: このほんはつまらなかったです
items.note: The past of an い-adjective always ends in かった (katta), so this is past affirmative even though the word looks negative.
items.reviewNote: Paradigm gap: boring / past affirmative. Constructed sentence, third of the このほんは〜 fixed frame.

items.target: とてもきれいでした
items.scene: answering how climbing Mt. Fuji was
items.reviewNote: Target Dialogue, Emma's reply to どうでしたか (dō deshita ka); the same line is also the answer for the ぎんざ・かぶき alternative in the last dialogue exercise. Deck has bare きれいでした (kirei deshita) as vocabulary but not the とても (totemo) reply.

items.target: このほんはつまらなくなかったです
items.reviewNote: Paradigm gap: boring / past negative. Constructed sentence, fourth of the このほんは〜 fixed frame; the two earlier cards in the frame carry the notes it builds on.

items.target: にほんごはかんたんじゃありません
items.note: な-adjectives negate like nouns, with じゃありません (ja arimasen). They never take the くない (kunai) ending that い-adjectives use.
items.reviewNote: Paradigm gap: easy / present negative. Constructed sentence, second of the にほんごは〜 fixed frame.

items.target: とてもおいしかったです
items.scene: answering how the tempura you ate in Asakusa was
items.reviewNote: Weekend Dialogue Exercise item 1 (おいしいです), Smith's closing line completed on the printed example とてもたのしかったです; the same sentence is printed verbatim in Speaking Practice 3. Elliptical, so it carries a scene.

items.target: どのくらいべんきょうをしましたか
items.pronunciation: dono kurai benkyō o shimashita ka
items.reviewNote: Excluded by the semantic de-dup pass. Pattern: どのくらい[verb]ましたか. Source already asks this question twice (どのくらいあるきましたか, どのくらいまちましたか); a third is padding.

items.target: きのうはあたたかかったです
items.reviewNote: Substitution Exercise A item 2 (あたたかいです), completed into a full sentence on the printed example きのうはさむかったです. Missing from the deck.

items.target: 30ぷんぐらいまちました
items.ttsText: さんじゅっぷんぐらいまちました
items.note: ぐらい (gurai) attaches straight onto the amount, after the counter, with no particle in between.
items.reviewNote: Adverb coverage for ぐらい with a length of time. Constructed sentence. The deck only has 5ふんぐらい as a bare phrase, never a minutes amount inside a sentence.

items.english: Yesterday I was free, but today I'm busy.
items.target: きのうはひまでしたが、きょうはいそがしいです
items.pronunciation: kinō wa hima deshita ga, kyō wa isogashii desu
items.reviewNote: Contrast Exercise item 1 (ひまです、いそがしいです), completed on the printed example きのうはいそがしかったですが、きょうはひまです. Only the example is carded.

items.english: It was hard, but it was fun.
items.target: たいへんでしたが、たのしかったです
items.reviewNote: Target Dialogue, Emma's closing line. It is the only place in the lesson where the が clause joins a な-adjective past to an い-adjective past, and it is missing from the deck.

items.english: It really is beautiful, isn't it?
items.target: ほんとうにきれいですね
items.note: Sasaki switches to the present ですね (desu ne) because she is looking at the photo now, even though Emma's trip is over.
items.reviewNote: Target Dialogue, Sasaki's comment on the photos. Lesson 10 carded ええ、ほんとうにさむいですね but not this one.

items.target: しゅっちょうはたいへんです
items.reviewNote: Paradigm gap: hard, tough / present affirmative. Constructed sentence, first of a three-card しゅっちょうは〜 fixed frame. The deck only has the fixed phrase たいへんでした, so this gives たいへん a topic of its own.

items.english: This is a souvenir from Hakone.
items.target: これ、はこねのおみやげです
items.note: The comma instead of は (wa) focuses the listener on これ (kore) before you say what it is. これははこねのおみやげです (kore wa hakone no omiyage desu) would be the version used when they are already looking at it.
items.reviewNote: Speaking Practice 2, Smith's line, singled out for comment in NOTES 3. おみやげ is carded as bare vocabulary only.

items.target: しゅっちょうはたいへんじゃありませんでした
items.pronunciation: shutchō wa taihen ja arimasen deshita
items.note: The past negative of a な-adjective just adds でした (deshita) onto the present negative: じゃありません (ja arimasen) becomes じゃありませんでした (ja arimasen deshita).
items.reviewNote: Paradigm gap: hard, tough / past negative. Constructed sentence, third of the しゅっちょうは〜 fixed frame.

items.target: ステーキはおいしくなかったです
items.reviewNote: Paradigm gap: delicious / past negative. Constructed sentence. Near-sibling of wave 1's とてもおいしかったです, but different noun, different form and a different English gloss, so no hint is needed.

items.english: Last week I went to Kyoto.
items.target: せんしゅうきょうとにいきました
items.note: せんしゅう (last week) needs no に of its own — きょうとに is the destination marker.
items.reviewNote: Excluded by the semantic de-dup pass. Pattern: [time] [place]に[verb]ました (past-tense travel). Source already teaches this frame twice (せんしゅうふじさんにのぼりました, しゅうまつにはこねにいきました), and the second uses the identical verb いきました — this card only swaps the place.

items.target: あさくさでてんぷらをたべました
items.reviewNote: Weekend Dialogue Exercise item 1 (あさくさ、てんぷらをたべます), completed on the printed example ほっかいどうでスキーをしました. The deck has the example and the ぎんざ/かぶき alternative but not this one.

items.target: しゅっちょうはたいへんじゃありません
items.reviewNote: Paradigm gap: hard, tough / present negative. Constructed sentence, second of the しゅっちょうは〜 fixed frame.

items.target: どのくらいまちましたか
items.reviewNote: Adverb coverage for どのくらい. Constructed sentence. Wave 1 has どのくらいあるきましたか from the dialogue; this is the only other verb the deck can support (まちます, Lesson 10) and pairs with p11-sanjuppun-gurai-machimashita.

items.english: We had a good time too.
items.target: わたしたちもたのしかったです
items.scene: replying to a guest who has just said she had a very nice time at your home
items.reviewNote: Speaking Practice 1, Sasaki's line. わたしたち is carded as bare vocabulary but the sentence it comes from is not.

items.target: きょうとでおすしをたべました
500にんぐらい
items.reviewNote: NOTES 1 example list. The deck already has the other two examples from that same list (5ふんぐらい and 1,000えんぐらい) but not this one.

items.target: はこねはどうでしたか
items.reviewNote: Speaking Practice 2, Nakamura's question. The deck has コンサートはどうでしたか and テストはどうでしたか but not the Speaking Practice one asking about a place.

items.target: きのうのおまつりはきれいじゃありませんでした
items.pronunciation: kinō no omatsuri wa kirei ja arimasen deshita
items.reviewNote: Substitution Exercise D item 1 (きれいです), completed on the printed example きのうのおまつりはにぎやかじゃありませんでした. Only the example is carded.

items.target: しゃしんをとりましたか
items.reviewNote: Target Dialogue, Sasaki's question. しゃしん and とります are carded as bare vocabulary but the question itself is missing.

items.english: I studied for about two hours.
items.target: ２じかんぐらいべんきょうをしました
items.ttsText: にじかんぐらいべんきょうをしました
items.reviewNote: Excluded by the semantic de-dup pass. Pattern: [number][counter]ぐらい[verb]ました. Answer to the removed question above, and source already gives this duration-answer pattern twice (８じかんぐらいあるきました, 30ぷんぐらいまちました).

items.target: ええ、これです
items.scene: answering whether you took photos on Mt. Fuji, holding out your phone
items.reviewNote: Target Dialogue, Emma's reply as she shows the photos. Elliptical answer, so it carries a scene. Not in the deck in any chapter.

items.target: きのうはあつかったです
items.reviewNote: Substitution Exercise A item 1 (あついです), completed into a full sentence on the printed example きのうはさむかったです. Only the example itself is in the deck.

items.target: しごとはたのしいです
items.reviewNote: Paradigm gap: fun / present affirmative. Constructed sentence, first of a fixed frame with f11-shigoto-wa-tanoshikunai-desu — only the inflection changes. Every existing たのしい card in the deck is past tense.

items.target: ロンドンはあつくなかったです
items.note: The past negative is built from the present negative: あつくない (atsukunai) drops ない (nai) and takes なかった (nakatta) instead.
items.reviewNote: Paradigm gap: hot / past negative. Constructed sentence, not a printed one. The deck already has とうきょうはあついですか and ロンドンはさむいですか, so this reuses a familiar city with the one form the tables never reached.

items.target: いいえ、むずかしくなかったです
items.scene: answering whether the test was difficult
items.reviewNote: Excluded by the semantic de-dup pass. Pattern: いいえ、[i-adj past negative]です. Paired with the removed question above; source already covers this answer pattern twice (いいえ、おもしろくなかったです / いいえ、やすくなかったです).

items.english: Last week I climbed Mt. Fuji.
items.target: せんしゅうふじさんにのぼりました
items.reviewNote: Target Dialogue, Emma's opening line. The deck has のぼります and ふじさん as vocabulary but never the sentence that sets up the whole lesson.

items.target: テストはむずかしいです
items.reviewNote: Paradigm gap: difficult / present affirmative. Constructed sentence, first of a fixed frame with f11-tesuto-wa-muzukashikunai-desu. The deck only has むずかしい in the past, attached to にほんごのクラス, so this uses テスト instead.

items.target: どのくらいあるきましたか
items.reviewNote: Target Dialogue and repeated in NOTES 1. どのくらい and あるきます are carded separately but the question is not.

items.english: Really? I'm glad to hear that.
items.target: そうですか、よかったです
items.scene: replying to a colleague who has just told you the souvenir you gave her was delicious
items.note: よかったです (yokatta desu) here is not describing the souvenir. It is the speaker's own reaction to the good news: 'I'm glad.'
items.reviewNote: Vocabulary coverage for よかったです in its 'I'm glad to hear that' sense. That sense sits in the deck only as a bare vocabulary card, and the Speaking Practice 3 line it comes from was not harvested in wave 1. The other よかったです cards in the deck all mean 'it was good', so this one carries a scene to keep the two apart.

items.target: いいえ、おもしろくなかったです
items.scene: answering whether the movie was interesting
items.reviewNote: Dialogue Exercise A, Smith's line in the printed example, the negative counterpart to Emma's. Missing from the deck; elliptical, so it carries a scene.

items.target: はい、おもしろかったです
items.scene: answering whether the movie was interesting
items.reviewNote: Dialogue Exercise A, Emma's line in the printed example. The deck has the question えいがはおもしろかったですか but neither of the two printed answers. Elliptical, so it carries a scene.

items.target: そのかばんは10,000えんぐらいでした
items.pronunciation: sono kaban wa ichiman en gurai deshita
items.ttsText: そのかばんはいちまんえんぐらいでした
items.reviewNote: Adverb coverage for ぐらい with a price. Constructed sentence. 1,000えんぐらい is in the deck as a bare phrase only, and no card puts a ぐらい price into a past-tense sentence.

items.target: ちちはいそがしくなかったです
items.reviewNote: Paradigm gap: busy / past negative. Constructed sentence, second of the ちちは〜 fixed frame.

items.english: Emma-san showed her photos to Sasaki-san and Sasaki-san's husband.
items.target: エマさんはささきさんとささきさんのごしゅじんにしゃしんをみせました
items.pronunciation: ema san wa sasaki san to sasaki san no goshujin ni shashin o misemashita
items.reviewNote: Target Dialogue, the narrative summary line printed after the dialogue. みせます is carded as bare vocabulary; this is the only printed sentence using it.

items.english: About 500 people came to the party.
items.target: パーティーに500にんぐらいきました
items.ttsText: パーティーにごひゃくにんぐらいきました

items.english: Yesterday it was warm, but today it's cold.
items.target: きのうはあたたかかったですが、きょうはさむいです
items.pronunciation: kinō wa atatakakatta desu ga, kyō wa samui desu
items.reviewNote: Contrast Exercise item 3 (あたたかいです、さむいです), completed on the printed example. Missing from the deck.

items.target: ちちはいそがしくないです
items.reviewNote: Paradigm gap: busy / present negative. Constructed sentence, first of a fixed frame with f11-chichi-wa-isogashikunakatta-desu. いそがしい only ever appears in the deck with a day as its topic, so this uses a person instead.

items.target: あまりかんたんじゃありませんでした
items.reviewNote: Dialogue Exercise B item 2 (テスト、かんたんです), Smith's line completed on the printed example あまりたのしくなかったです. The deck has the question and Emma's とてもかんたんでした but not Smith's negative. Elliptical, so it carries a scene.

items.english: I wasn't free on the weekend.
items.target: しゅうまつはひまじゃありませんでした
items.pronunciation: shūmatsu wa hima ja arimasen deshita
items.reviewNote: Paradigm gap: free, not busy / past negative. Constructed sentence, second of the しゅうまつは〜 fixed frame; the な-adjective past-negative note sits on f11-shutchou-wa-taihen-ja-arimasen-deshita.

items.target: きのうのデートはよくなかったです
items.pronunciation: kinō no dēto wa yokunakatta desu
items.reviewNote: Substitution Exercise B item 2 (いいです), completed on the printed example きのうのデートはたのしくなかったです. The irregular よくなかったです only appears in the deck as a bare form, never in a sentence.

items.target: にほんごはかんたんです
items.reviewNote: Paradigm gap: easy / present affirmative. Constructed sentence, first of a fixed frame with f11-nihongo-wa-kantan-ja-arimasen. Both existing かんたん cards are about テスト and are past tense, so this changes the noun.

items.target: あまりよくなかったです
items.reviewNote: Dialogue Exercise B item 1 (コンサート、いいです), Smith's line completed on the printed example あまりたのしくなかったです. The deck has the question and Emma's とてもよかったです but not Smith's negative. Elliptical, so it carries a scene.

items.target: ほっかいどうはさむくなかったです
items.reviewNote: Paradigm gap: cold / past negative. Constructed sentence. Deliberately not きのうは〜, which the printed exercises already own; ほっかいどう comes from Lesson 6.

items.target: しごとはたのしくないです
items.reviewNote: Paradigm gap: fun / present negative. Constructed sentence, second of the しごとは〜 fixed frame.

items.target: いいえ、やすくなかったです
items.scene: answering whether the sale was cheap
items.reviewNote: Dialogue Exercise A item 1, Smith's line completed on the printed example いいえ、おもしろくなかったです. Elliptical answer, so it carries a scene.

items.target: きのうのデートはおもしろくなかったです
items.pronunciation: kinō no dēto wa omoshirokunakatta desu
items.reviewNote: Substitution Exercise B item 1 (おもしろいです), completed on the printed example きのうのデートはたのしくなかったです. Only the example is carded.

items.english: I'm not free on the weekend.
items.target: しゅうまつはひまじゃありません
items.reviewNote: Paradigm gap: free, not busy / present negative. Constructed sentence, first of a fixed frame with f11-shuumatsu-wa-hima-ja-arimasen-deshita. Both existing ひま cards use きょう or きのう, so this moves to しゅうまつ.

items.target: テストはむずかしかったですか
items.reviewNote: Excluded by the semantic de-dup pass. Pattern: [topic]は[i-adj past]ですか. Source already teaches this question form (セールはやすかったですか) plus two いいえ+i-adj-past-negative answers, so this is a redundant third example.
